carouselPost:
What a URL Review finds on the best sites we read.

We read 114 public sites, 2,227 pages across 11 countries. The top site in each of five sectors still had one thing to fix first:

→ MDN Web Docs, 95: Permissions-Policy is not sent
→ GOV.UK, 92: 19 pages have no canonical link
→ Node.js, 89: Other sites can frame the page
→ Cloudflare, 88: Security headers on the start page are missing on other pages
→ World Bank, 87: No content security policy

Swipe for the six area scores and what each site already does well.

One automated read of public pages on 19 Oct 2026. A starting point, not a verdict.
Your first review is included, up to 20 pages: https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review.html?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=premium-carousel
